text: The illustration sidecar can be rewritten with a headline-glued, truncated alt (observed 'Your 6 Fixes, One Hidden Code. Insurance notice and public file pages... roof type', 118 chars) and its typography overlay can be set from the lead and clipped mid-sentence ('...refused to keep a home policy. Each'). Both survive the publish summary because the render gate reads bytes, not copy. After a persistence pass, read the header pixels with vision and diff the sidecar alt against the artifact: retype the overlay free with illustration_overlay.apply_to_slug(slug, force_copy=...) from featured.base.jpg, then fix alt/caption in the sidecar, the artifact, the Supabase metadata and the attachment, and push the corrected bytes with wp_draft.py --slug <slug> --reimage (update_media alone changes meta, not pixels). The front can keep serving the old alt until the attachment meta lands.

An evergreen brief whose rows are word-number rules (three claims, two refusals) passes the gate on a loose phrase match, so lead each cell with the figure and then gloss it — and put the year inside the clause, not the bullet lead-in, because readability_critic counts a year in the lead-in as a second figure.

illustration_overlay.py re-composite REUSES the sidecar's stored overlay copy ('keep the copy stable'); its --dry-run derives fresh copy but the real run does not. After any title change, re-type the overlay by calling apply_to_slug(slug, force_copy={kicker,title,hook}) or the hero keeps the superseded headline. Then re-upload the binary to media (REST POST /media/<id>), regenerate the unregistered -1024x576 hero variant by hand (PIL crop from the new base; wp_generate_attachment_metadata does not make it), and redeploy all three fronts via giniloh_coolify_redeploy_all() from container wordpress-pwgow8ow48g88go880cs (the mu-plugin exists only there; the wellroost uploads live in container wordpress-o8gg8osos44sckk800owcc44, and both sites have their own media id 481).
